name: the Préfargier park
title: Ancient Trees in the Parc de Préfargier, Laténa: 5 to Find
meta_description: Three Atlas cedars with one crown, a curtain of weeping beeches and a dawn redwood in autumn colour. Five trees in the Préfargier park, Laténa.
intro: Three Atlas cedars stand together on one lawn in the Préfargier park, in the commune of Laténa in the canton of Neuchâtel, and their crowns have grown into a single dark pyramid. A second cedar stands tall on the lawn, and a reader measured its girth at 705 centimetres. Three weeping beeches grow together too, and their drooping branches have joined into one curtain of leaves that reaches almost to the ground. A dawn redwood a reader photographed in autumn was burnt orange from top to bottom, at a girth they gave as 250 centimetres. Near the wall, a large-leaved lime has a wide, even dome and many slender stems rising straight from its main limbs, as if it had been cut back to a stool long ago. All five were sent by readers, so ages are not documented, and we describe the trees as the photographs show them.
